messages.subject: memory problem
messages.body_plain:
Hi Perry :
 I was a bit surprised when trying to run a code in nimble: The data is a
1176*35 RH matrix. I get the message: error:impossible to allocate a vector
 of 12.3 Go.Warning messages:
 1: In integer(maxNewEdges) : Reached total allocation of 12287Mb: see
 help(memory.size).
 This code runs fine under Win7 64 bits and R64 with jags ; also
 in nimble when data is a 587*12 matrix with only a warning related to memory. I've tried to increase memory
 through memory.limit(size=50000) but with no success.
 In R help I've seen: It is not normally possible to allocate as much as
 2Gb to a single vector in a 32-bit build of R even on 64-bit Windows because
 of preallocations by  Windows in the middle of the address space. But is
 this relevant?
I have attached  the code in question, but not the data file itself.
 I would be very pleased if you could help, many thanks,
Gilbert.
